avis.texte: This has become a staple for me! I started with the beginner retinol and now use this about 5 nights/week. My skin reflects using it also. Age shots and blemishes seem to deminish over time with consistent use!

This has become a routine staple for me. I did have to begin with the beginner retinol and graduate to using this in my daily routine. Early "training" I had some dryness/redness around my nose. But learned my tolerance of every other day and now its part of my daily routine with great results. My skin feels and looks more youthful and I have little to no issues with blemish prone skin right now. Love this affordable retinol product. Long lasting too!

I've been using the to replace my Granactive Retinoid 2% Emulsion from The Ordinary. As directed, I use it about twice a week, and so far, so good. I always pair with a good moisturizer (something with ceramides or squalane) so I haven't experienced any issues with dryness.

avis.titre: Bummed- Burns Even After Beg. Use
avis.texte: I am pretty bummed about this product. Clearly, retinol is not for me. I used the beginners retinol from Cocokind brand, and use the entire tube before going to this advanced formula, starting one time per week. Each time I have used it, this is four now, it has burned my face and caused a really rough texture that needs to heal.
I use this religiously and it truly changed my skin! I almost never break out anymore and overall my skin seems smoother and clearer.
So far so good but i havent used it long enough to see results

I'm a big fan of this retinol cream. I started with the beginner retinol and moved up to the advanced retinol with no issues. It helps improve the texture of my skin, has faded some acne scarring and doesn't irritate my skin. Love it!

avis.titre: Valuable part of my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this retinol. I use it everyday and have not had any issues. My skin has always been pretty good, however as I'm nearing 40, I want to be proactive and this seems to be a valuable part of my new skin routine.
I really love this and think it's been helping with my fine lines. The key is consistency! I like that I can build on my favorite products with this.

This is a great retinol! I havent been using it too long, but i swear everytime i use it my acne scars are a little more faded when i wake up the next morning. I have sensitive skin so i use some products first so its not too drying, but my skin really seems to like it!

avis.titre: Great for beginners and advanced users!
avis.texte: Love using this on my neck since I apply tret on my face. The texture is almost buttery more than the 0.1% gel.

I'm a huge fan of this one! My first time using retinol, and even though I have somewhat sensitive skin, I find this to be gentle. I only use it about twice a week and if my skin is feeling on the dry side, I will use a light barrier serum between my skin and the retinol. I've never had any irritation.
Great retinol but listen to their instructions. This is stronger, so start with their smaller dose. I definitely layer my face with moisturizer and serums when I use this.

i used the beginner retinol for a while (2 tubes worth) and recently upgraded. the first time or two it felt a little sensitive, but now i am using it every other day and my skin tolerates it really well!

avis.titre: Cocokinds Advanced Retinol: Gentle, Effective, Affordable
avis.texte: Ive been a fan of Cocokind for over 10 years�ever since I discovered they were using a seed from Peru (I believe it was called Inka Sacha or golden elixir). Being from Peru myself, I was instantly drawn to the brand and curious about their process. Since then, Ive tried almost all of their products and have continued to love them through the years. My absolute favorite is the Advanced Retinol. Its one of the very few retinol products that doesnt irritate my sensitive skin, yet I can feel it working. I also like to double-check my skincare with the Yuka app (which is very popular in Europe), and this product scores really wellâ€"its made with high-quality ingredients and none of the �bad stuff. On top of all that, the price is incredibly fairalmost half the cost of many other retinol products on the market. Thank you, Cocokind, for making effective, gentle, and trustworthy products that I can keep coming back to!
A fantastic retinol for tenured retinol users! Does exactly what you need it to do at a great price
I gave this a try. I use retinol on a daily basis but this dried me out completely and made my skin look worse. I tried using it only every 3 days and moisturized the same as normal.
So easy to use and it does not irritate my sensitive skin. Thank goodness I found cocokind!
I was looking to switch up the retinol in my skincare and this one did absolutely ✨nothing✨ for me. Cera Ve resurfacing retinol i will never betray you again. (I have dry skin with hormonal acne)

finally a retinol cream that works. I have been using retinol for a few years now but this is the best one. It doesn't peel my skin or anything but really smoothed out my skin. I use it 2-3 times a night and it does the job.

avis.titre: One of the best I've tried
avis.texte: Of the many OTC retinols ive tried over the years, this one takes the cake. I love the gel texture and saw results after only a few weeks. I get the most compliments on my skin when using this consistently. Plus i cant beat the price point!! Im a fan for life, cocokind please never stop making this!
I have absolutely loved this product! It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and looking plump in a good way. Itss almost like I can tell my cells are regenerating faster!

I was experiencing heavier breakouts than I have in years and decided to change my skincare routine. I incorporated this retinol 3x/week at night and noticed calmer skin the next day. I notice decreased blemishes in combination with salicylic acid and benzyl peroxide. A must-have for your skincare routine!

avis.titre: Great for mixing w your moisturizer
avis.texte: Highly recommend for "cocktailing" with whatever evening moisturizer works for your skin! I really did not like this at first - it stained my pillows that famous retinal yellow. Gross! But when I started mixing it with my usual cream, voila! Great skin effects and zero icky pillow marks :) A request though... this product is clearly stronger than Cocokind's own beginner formula, but it's not that strong for experienced retinoid users. I recommend this product for it's formulation and combo of retinoid "speeds" but in my opinion it's an intermediate strength. I implore the awesome Cocokind team to make a stronger version with more retinAL that can compete with products for more experienced users that still want the benefits of the soothing ingredients. Please? Lovinah's retinal serum is a good example (but is way overpriced IMHO!) :D

This product did not end up working for me, which is completely my fault. I tend to be sensitive to retinols but recently have been tolerating a 3% retinol serum just fine, so I reached for this advanced 5% as a step up. I used it for about three weeks, at first I had severe burning and irritation. Then, I worked my way up to every other day with limited irritation, but I still had very faint, pesky, red patches. Upon looking into this product further I discovered it contains Retinal, Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate and Lactic acid. Going from a regular retinol to a retinal, retinol and lactic acid was a bigger jump than I bargained for and looking back I should have opted for their beginner product at 2% as retinal being included makes it much stronger. I did however, notice the tightening effect starting and my skill cell turnover rate immediately speed up. Awesome over the counter strength and results in under 3 weeks, just too strong for me!!

Has made my large pores basically invisible. I alternate between this and the beginners retinol because I do have dry skin so I have to be careful not to dry it out further. I use this one-two times a week and then use the beginners on the other days and Iâ€™ve had no issues with it drying me out
I really enjoy this product. It does not irritate my skin and I am able to use it frequently. It cuts down on my breakouts and keeps my skin texture in check.

My skin shouted 'HOORAY' from the first night I applied this. Something about this formula is a thousand times better than the beginner's retinol. I don't have any hydration problems with this at all! In fact, when I don't use it my skin is unhappier, and breaks out or flakes. Enough so that I almost never skipped, despite it taking nearly two months to fully acclimate. (I am stubborn about pain, and since all I experienced when I upgraded was very brief initial redness to go with my sensitized skin on face/neck, I just pushed through.) Is it the aloe in the gel? I'm not sure! But my skin looks dramatically better, finally usually entirely breakout-free, and my milia have been slowly going away too. Love this product!

I've only been using this product twice a week for a month and have already seen noticeable improvement in my skin's texture, fine lines, and acne control. I have dry/sensitive skin and was using the beginner cocokind retinol for the last year consistently until it just stopped working for me. I was hesitant to purchase since the jump from .01% to .5% felt drastic but starting little by little as the directions suggest has seemed to help my skin so much!

I love this product. I began using it slowly as directed. I am up to every other night, alternating with another prescription product. My skin is looking great. Dark dark spots are lightning and skin texture is smooth and even.
I just received my 0.5% retinol and the tube feel warm to touch when I first open it. I am not sure the if it will lose its potency in the warn temperatures of usps truck

I had a deep line in my forehead that the Beginners Retinol started working on, so after 4 weeks I graduated to Advanced Retinol Gel and wow! ðŸ˜ðŸ˜ðŸ˜This gel has made that line nonexistent. Truly gone after 4 weeks. Im still using it and will finish the entire tube before graduating to a 1% formulation- which Im a bit nervous about since it will be the first time using a non CocoKind product in a long time. I trust this brand immensely and hope they will add stronger retinols in the future!
This is my new holy grail of retinols! It is perfect for my 43 year old skin, it does not dry it out and it does not burn or sting. Which is super important for me!

I transitioned from the Cocokind Beginner Retinol to this one slowly by mixing the two and then moved over to the Advanced. As someone with chronic illness that is sensitive to most every beauty product, I switched over to Cocokind years ago because it was the only brand I found at the time that didnt cause a reaction. Ive been hooked ever since. Theyve done it again with this product. Im amazed Im able to use any retinol product without irritation let alone an advanced formula. Im so grateful to the wizards behind this magic!
Used the original starter retinol and am very pleased with this stronger formula. Great to alternate between the two.

I am liking this product just as much as the .2 retinol. No irritation using it every other day of week. It does help with locking in hydration and skin tone in general. Cant say it has helped with the little lines or bigger red spots yet. Just been using for about 4 weeks at this point.

This Advanced Retinol Gel 0.5% is one of their newest products. Ive been using it for 3 months and have really been enjoying the experience. I have previously tried their Beginner Retinol Gel 0.1% and I prefer the Advanced one. I find both Retinol products to be incredibly gentle. The reason why I lean more towards the Advanced Retinol gel is because of the increased percentage of retinol and the effects it had with consistent use. I felt that the Advanced Retinol Gel improved the look of fine lines. The formula is incredible gentle. I started off slow and worked my way up to using this every other day. I did not have any of the effects that can sometimes happen with incorporating retinol into your skincare. Above all I found this product to be gentle and effective.
Love the texture and consistency. Havent used it long enough to see a difference yet. As with all products, you have to give them time. I love Cocoakind products.

Ive been loving this advanced retinol. Ive also used the beginner retinol, which Im a huge fan of! I havent been using this product too long, so its hard to speak to the efficacy at this point. The feeling of the product is similar to the beginner version. It layers nicely under other products and hasnt irritated my skin. Im really enjoying this product and hopeful for amazing results with continued use.

This has been a game changer for my skin. My pores are much clearer and because of that, they are less noticeable. The product is gently, no irritating for my skin, and effective. I was hoping for an advanced retinol and I started using the beginners with no issues. I look forward to applying every night because I know it is making a difference for me. I have even received several compliments on the changes in my skin!
The 0.5% retinol cream does not irritate my skin at all, and I use it everyday. If for some reason I do get irritation, I use the lower intensity retinol and all is well.
Great and not too harsh. No worries about peeling but still get the resurfacing benefits

I began with the lower % retinol and built my way to this one. Great product. Start with 3 x a week and use a gentle cleaners (like the cream to oil cleanser) to keep your skin moisturized. It has not irritated my skin, which has been great. Looking forward to seeing the result after using it for a few months.

avis.titre: Easy to make the shift to .5%
avis.texte: I've stopped using retinols in the past because I hated how they made my skin feel so dry. It was always a pain to try and mitigate that. This retinoid and the .1% are phenomenal in that it doesn't make your skin feel dry. I started out using the .1% and made the switch to this, no problem. I started using the retinols for fine lines- if I'm honest, I haven't seen any changes even though I've been using consistently. I'll keep looking out, but it doesn't feel as there are any changes. I'm also concerned about the long term impact of using retinol on my skin.

I originally had tried the beginner retinol and I didnt experience much change in my skin. I then got to try this stronger strength version and I like it much more. After using it for an almost a couple of months now, Im quite happy with it. At this point I use it almost every other night, but skip sometimes and wait a couple-few days between uses here and there to make sure to not overwhelm my skin. It seems to help any acne that I get, heal faster, as retinol helps skin cells turnover quicker I believe. Also, the morning after using it the night before, I always notice how smooth and calm my skin appears. Ill definitely keep using it and it will be a repeat purchase for me going forward. Thanks cocokind, love you!
A winner for my skin! It feels firmer and refreshing each day!

avis.titre: A great addition to my skin care routine
avis.texte: I was using the 0.1 retinol and then tried this new formula. It did not irritate my sensitive skin and having been using it daily. I love how my skin feels firmer and clearer without any irritation. Easy to apply.
Definitely loving this one and I didn't experience irritation even though it is stronger. :)

Great for sensitive skin! My skin responded well to the beginner retinol and was hopeful that I could tolerate the advanced. No reaction after first application or weeks after trialing it. My skin felt smoother and looked clearer ðŸ'•

This formula is great for my sensitive skin! My skin tends to get red and irritated even by the gentlest product, and this retinol didn't irritate me at all! the formula is super pleasant and fragrance-free. I look forward to continuing to use it and see results!

I've been using this for about 2 months now. I've had no irritations or reactions too it. My skin has become noticeably smoother and even. I'm consistently seeing improvements and excited to see what long term use does.
I really enjoyed how plump and moisturized and firm this made my skin look after each use.

I am such a huge fan of this new advanced retinol. It works great I noticed my skin was smoother and darker marks disappeared very fast. I pair it with the ceramide barrier serum and the resurrection polypeptide cream to prevent dryness and it's a perfect combination. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

I'm absolutely obsessed with this advanced retinol! It's a total game-changer for my skin. I've noticed a remarkable improvement in texture and tone. Using it at night with the ceramide barrier serum and then sealing it in with the resurrection polypeptide cream has been a dream combo. My skin feels hydrated and looks amazing. I wholeheartedly recommend this product!

I've tried other retinols and tretinoin, but I have extremely sensitive skin and always end up peeling and irritated. This retinol not only didn't irritate my skin, it worked well!! My dark spots lightened quickly and I feel like my skin texture improved overall.
I love how much it improved my acne and skin texture while also being gentle enough to use nightly. Great product!
Love this retinol gel!! Cocokind nails yet another skincare product. I recommend using 1-2x a week at first and then walking your way to more as your skin adjusts.

avis.titre: Great for those of us already used to a retinoid -- what we'
avis.texte: Love this product! I've been using it for a few weeks, and feel like my skin is making progress. For reference, I'm 26, use a retinoid for both acne and general maintenance, and have medically-sensitive skin. I had some temporary burning the first few times I used this, but it gets less with each use. This isn't unusual for me -- a lot of products do that occasionally. I switched to this from a similar-strength retinoid of another brand that I'd already worked up to using every night, so I've been using this every night from the start along with the oil-to-milk cleanser, ceramide serum, and polypeptide cream. My partner, who has less sensitive, slightly oilier skin has also been using it. She's also noticed a visible improvement in her skin, and even went camping without having the usual breakouts from the dust. She only has light burning when it's on an area that's been irritated by something else. She uses it in the evenings along with the AHA jelly cleanser and ceramide serum. Definitely a new favorite for us! This is an honest review in exchange for a free advance sample of the product.
This retinol made a huge impact on my skin! My acne became nonexistent. My skin is more even and smooth! I love it. Not harsh at all either.

avis.titre: This retinol left my skin glowing, plump and even!
avis.texte: This retinol left my skin glowing! With more even texture and fewer fine lines I love this product. The texture was also amazing and felt much more luxury than the price would have you think.
Fantastic, non sticky/tacky texture. Dries super well on the skin. Minimally irritating in comparison to other retinols

I'm going to be adding this item to my nightly routine. The product goes on smoothly and absorbs pretty well into the skin. There is no scent that I can detect. My skin isn't too sensitive, so I've been fine using this nightly

I absolutely love this retinol! It's pleasant to use, and I haven't experienced any irritation, even around my neck and eyes, which are usually very sensitive. The texture feels like a very hydrating gel that instantly plumps my skin. As someone with eczema, I'm always looking for products approved by the National Eczema Association, and seeing that this product is approved gives me such peace of mind. This is definitely going to become a regular part of my and my parents' skincare routine.

avis.titre: I noticed a remarkable firming and plumping effect on my ski
avis.texte: From the first application, I noticed a remarkable firming and plumping effect on my skin. It feels rejuvenated, which is especially impressive considering the gentle formulation. My 74-year-old mom stole some from me, and she thinks it makes her fine lines better! She kept telling me, "Look, look!" The texture of the cream is lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it a pleasant addition to my nightly skincare routine. I appreciate how easy it is to apply and how it leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed. Overall, Advanced Retinol Gel 0.5% has become a staple in my skincare regimen. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle yet effective retinol product that delivers noticeable firming and plumping benefits. This is a game-changer, and I'm sure it will be for others too!

The best retinol product I've ever used, smells great, had no adverse effects and my skin has truly never felt softer. Noticeably clearer skin, less acne, more even skin tone, can't say enough about how great this product is!
I love the tube, smell and feel of this formula! It took a few weeks for my skin to get used to it but now my skin loves it. My skin feels and looks tighter and firmer.
I liked the flow of the product. It is not stiff yet not a liquid. It makes the product easy to apply and soak into the skin.
I liked the texture of this gel, and it did not bother my reactive and sensitive skin.

avis.titre: For anyone that is thinking of trying retinol for the first
avis.texte: It's a perfect product for anyone with sensitive skin. Other retinol products have dried or irritated my skin while this one made me have glowing and hydrated skin.
